approved_python_scratch_proposal:
# Blocking requirement decision: selected cron's private Python scratch directory

Existing authority conflicts: REQ-RUN-0503 criterion6 (docs/requirements.md:3357), REQ-RUN-0701 obligation6 (3595–3596), and its criterion1 (3672) forbid every tempfile/tempdir package in the daemon normal dependency tree. Separately, docs/sc-cron/requirements.md:151 permits tempfile as a normal sc-cron dependency; actual production `sc_cron::process::TempCwd` uses `tempfile::TempDir` (crates/sc-cron/src/process.rs:213–222) to isolate Python hooks. The C4 selected default now makes that already implemented path reachable. The full no-edit sequence compiles both binaries and fails the old graph guard. No guard, requirement, dependency or temporary-directory implementation has been changed to bypass it.

Proposed exact replacements (approval required):

1. REQ-RUN-0503 success criterion6: “The same job then runs `just build-daemon` in `$RUNNER_TEMP/app`, and it exits0. That recipe includes `cargo tree -p <project>-daemon -e normal --prefix none` and an automated normal-dependency ancestry check. `tempdir` is forbidden. `tempfile` is allowed only as the existing direct normal dependency of the qualified `sc-cron` package for private Python-hook scratch directories; every normal path from the daemon to that package must pass through `sc-cron`. A direct daemon dependency or any other direct/transitive ancestry fails. Daemon instance roots, endpoints, locks and application database paths must still never use a temporary-directory API in production.”
2. REQ-RUN-0701 command-list obligation6: “`just build-daemon` inside the generated project at `<dest>`. It includes `cargo tree -p <project>-daemon -e normal --prefix none` and the same normal-dependency ancestry check required by REQ-RUN-0503 criterion6. It fails for any `tempdir`, any direct daemon `tempfile` edge, or any `tempfile` ancestry outside the qualified `sc-cron` private Python scratch path. Amended by this explicitly approved selected-cron clarification.”
3. REQ-RUN-0701 success criterion1, final daemon sentence only: “`just build-daemon` includes `cargo tree -p <project>-daemon -e normal --prefix none` and the normal-dependency ancestry check from REQ-RUN-0503 criterion6. Those checks run because the job runs the recipes; they are not a separate manual step.” Preserve the rest of that criterion verbatim.

Guard acceptance cases:

- PASS: no tempfile/tempdir normal dependency (unselected cron).
- PASS: selected qualified sc-cron→tempfile direct normal edge, and all normal daemon-to-tempfile paths pass through that sc-cron identity; private scratch remains owned/cleaned by core Python runner.
- FAIL: daemon→tempfile, even if selected cron also legitimately uses the same resolved tempfile identity.
- FAIL: daemon→other-package→tempfile, including a second ancestry into the same tempfile identity.
- FAIL: sc-cron→other-package→tempfile without the qualified direct edge; do not allow arbitrary subtrees by name.
- FAIL: any normal tempdir dependency, including beneath sc-cron.
- Retain existing production scans preventing temporary daemon instance-root paths. Keep CLI normal graph's server/cron/SQLite/Monty exclusions unchanged. Dev/build-only paths are outside the normal graph check and must not create a false exemption.

Implementation after approval would inspect real normal resolve edges/package identities and reject alternate ancestry; it would not blanket allowlist the package name, turn off build-daemon, remove real Python isolation, or replace safe tempfile with hand-rolled temporary directories.
